sermons.title: The Battlefield of the Mind
summary: The battle for your life is won or lost in your thought life.
Wrong thinking produces wrong emotions and wrong behaviour.
Renew the mind daily by meditating on God's Word.

sermons.title: Loving Yourself the Way God Does
summary: You can't love others well until you receive God's love for yourself.
Rejecting yourself is rejecting God's workmanship.
Practise thanking God for who He made you to be.

sermons.title: Freedom from Worry and Anxiety
summary: Worry is meditating on the problem instead of the Problem-solver.
Cast your cares — don't carry what God offered to carry.
Praying with thanksgiving guards the heart with supernatural peace.
